courses.title: Modern Threats 2026
courses.subtitle: Passkeys, AI agents and the quantum clock.

blocks.title: A familiar voice is no longer proof
blocks.body: AI voice cloning needs only a few seconds of audio. Scammers phone relatives or finance teams pretending to be someone they trust and ask for urgent money or codes. Urgency and secrecy are the red flags.
Your boss calls in a panic and asks for an urgent gift-card purchase. Best first move?
options: Hang up and call back on a number you already know
Buy the cards, then check later
Ask them to read out the card codes
Reply on the same call with your password
blocks.explanation: Calling back on a known number defeats voice cloning because the attacker does not control that line.

blocks.body: Which habit protects a family best against voice-clone scams?
blocks.explanation: A pre-agreed safe-word is something a cloned voice cannot know.
